title: 4-Sum Problem
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Return all unique quadruplets summing to a target.
intuition: Exactly 3-Sum with one more fixed index. The skip-duplicates discipline is applied at all four levels.

approaches.title: Optimal: two nested loops + two pointers
approaches.idea: Sort once; skip duplicates at i, j, lo and hi.
approaches.whyWorks: Fixing two indices reduces to sorted 2-Sum, which is linear.

commonMistakes: Skipping j duplicates with `j > 0` instead of `j > i + 1`
Forgetting that the sum can overflow 32-bit ints in other languages
patternRecognition: k-Sum -> fix k-2 indices and run two pointers
followUps: Count quadruplets instead of listing them
Can you beat O(n^3)? (meet in the middle, O(n^2 log n))
interviewInsight: The meet-in-the-middle O(n^2) pair-hash answer is a strong bonus if you have time to mention it.
